entries.name: Chocolate protein berry smoothie
entries.quantity: 30 g frozen blueberries, 45 g frozen mixed berries, 150 mL full-cream milk, 59 g raw egg, 1 scoop Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard Double Rich Chocolate whey, 55 g ice
entries.notes: Confirmed full-cream milk and raw egg (59 g). Berry calories from package labels; standard ~30 g whey scoop assumed. Raw unpasteurised egg carries Salmonella risk; pasteurised egg is safer.

daily_summary.notes: Partial day. Only smoothie reported so far.
